Publication statement: [Wuchang] : Hubei guan shu ju, [after 1870]
Shows coastal area from Yellow River in Jiangsu Province, through Korea, Manchuria, to Xilin River in Russia.

Shows coastal area from Yellow River in Jiangsu Province, through Korea, Manchuria, to Xilin River in Russia. Wood block print. Relief shown pictorially. Scale ca. 1:2,500,000. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Previous call number: G9237.E3 1864 .H81 Vault AACR2
